name: GCP Cloud SQL Operations Agent
description: Google Cloud SQL Operations Agent with instance and user inspection, read-only SQL diagnostics, Cloud Logging & Monitoring observability, and official GCP Knowledge lookup.

skills.name: Cloud SQL Instance & Read-Only Query Diagnostics
skills.description: Lists and inspects Google Cloud SQL instances, database users, operations, upgrade prechecks, and executes read-only diagnostic queries.
examples: List all Cloud SQL instances in the project and inspect their configuration and state
List users and recent operations for a Cloud SQL instance

skills.name: GCP Cloud Logging & Monitoring Diagnostics
skills.description: Queries Cloud Logging entries and Cloud Monitoring time-series metrics and alerts for Cloud SQL databases.
examples: Check recent Cloud SQL error logs and CPU/memory/connection utilization metrics

skills.name: GCP Documentation & Best Practices Lookup
skills.description: Searches official Google Cloud documentation and architecture guides for Cloud SQL best practices.
examples: What are the official GCP best practices for Cloud SQL high availability and connection pooling?
